meta.parties: Associated Cement Companies Ltd., Bombay v. Commissioner of Income Tax

rules.statement: Section 84(1) of the Ordinance does not apply to claims made under section 46(1).
rules.supporting_quote: "The fallacy in this argument lies in ignoring proviso (ii) of section 84 (1). It is true that in the 'first example referred' to earlier A would have been entitled to claim Rs. 200 if the amount with which he was ' properly chargeable ' is regarded as Rs. 900 but the proviso (ii) proceeds to say that A cannot .claim anything more than Rs. 100 when it enacts that ' he shall not be entitled by virtue of this section to any relief greater than that provided by .... section 43 (3)."
